description: This file defines an abstract class TransactionConcurrencyTestRunner for testing transaction concurrency scenarios in Orleans, including shared grains, transaction chains, and transaction trees.

classes.name: TransactionConcurrencyTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to test concurrent transaction scenarios involving shared grains, transaction chains, and transaction trees.

methods.name: SingleSharedGrainTest
methods.description: Tests concurrent transactions sharing a single grain and verifies the expected state.

methods.name: TransactionChainTest
methods.description: Tests a chain of dependent transactions across multiple grains.

methods.name: TransactionTreeTest
methods.description: Tests a transaction tree with dependencies between grains.
